bio: Carina and Christoph Schmah now have a wonderful second eatery for their hotel and restaurant, Landhaus Halferschenke, in the form of this small fine dining restaurant. Behind the pretty quarry stone façade of this historical building, the space has a pleasantly calm and elegant atmosphere. Expert wine recommendations come courtesy of the cordial and proficient service team. The food is modern but grounded in the classics, with the chef-patron rustling up a six- to eight-course set menu out of top-notch ingredients. The restaurant has just four tables, for up to 12 guests, so be sure to book!...
